partnerOnboarding.title: Partner onboarding
partnerOnboarding.subtitle: Complete your profile and documents so CLOX can activate your territory seat.
partnerOnboarding.docsHint: Upload ABN extract, government ID, and signed Master Administration Agreement (document or image).
partnerOnboarding.declAccuracy: I declare the information and documents provided are accurate.
partnerOnboarding.declNda: I agree to confidentiality / NDA obligations for CLOX operations data.
partnerOnboarding.declNonCompete: I acknowledge non-compete / exclusivity terms in the Master Administration Agreement.
partnerOnboarding.waitingOps: CLOX Super Admin is reviewing your application. You will be emailed when approved.
partnerOnboarding.rejected: Your partner application was rejected. Contact Super Admin if you need a new invite.
partnerOnboarding.readyBody: Grow your territory by inviting companies. Use Growth tools for invites and your book of business.

partnerPerformance.title: Partner performance
partnerPerformance.subtitle: Book of business plus stats — adjust each admin’s personal Super/State/Local package.
partnerPerformance.banner: Split % follows the person who onboarded the sender. Changing one admin’s package does not change another admin on the same territory.
partnerPerformance.windowLine: Last {{days}} days · BoB median active companies {{median}} · National Super {{super}}% / State {{state}}% / Local {{local}}%
partnerPerformance.seatLine: Jobs {{jobs}} · Gross {{gross}} · Accrued admin {{accrued}} · Peers on territory {{peers}}
partnerPerformance.adjustHint: Carrier takes national {{carrier}}%. Super + State + Local must sum to platform pool of {{target}}%. Peers keep their own packages. Applies to new accruals for senders they onboarded.

opsPartners.title: Admin partners
opsPartners.subtitle: Invite State Masters and Local BDEs. They complete KYB before ops access is activated.
opsPartners.name: Name
opsPartners.noTerritories: No territories for this region yet
opsPartners.emptyHint: Invite from here or from an EOI lead.
opsPartners.disableBody: Suspend {{name}}. Ops access is revoked until you reactivate.
opsPartners.reactivateBody: Restore {{name}} to their previous company status.
opsPartners.deleteBody: Permanently delete {{name}} and their invite. This cannot be undone.

growth.title: Growth pipeline
growth.subtitle: Your referred prospects and book of business — not everyone in the territory.
growth.inviteSubtitle: They register via your link and join your book of business. Commission applies when invited senders book and pay — inviting carriers builds supply, not automatic trip commission.
growth.inviteCreatedNoMail: Invite created (email skipped — copy the link)
growth.bookSearchPlaceholder: Search business name, email, or invite…
growth.prospectExplainBody: A prospect is a sender or carrier you are chasing before they register — your CRM notepad (name, stage, notes). Sending an invite does not create a sender/carrier yet. They only appear under My senders / My carriers after they open your invite link and complete registration.
growth.bookFunnelBody: Pending invites are people you emailed who have not registered yet. Registered accounts are those who used your link and joined your book.
growth.pendingInvitesHint: Invites you sent that are still waiting for registration.
growth.emptyPendingInvitesHint: Use Invite sender / carrier to email a registration link.
growth.registeredBookHint: Senders or carriers that completed signup with your invite.
growth.emptyProspectsHint: Add a prospect to track outreach, or invite a sender / carrier directly.
growth.myBookHint: Your referred book — pending invites and registered senders / carriers.
growth.emptyBookHint: When someone accepts your invite and registers, they show up here.
growth.reassignBody: Move {{name}} to another Local BDE, or clear to HQ.
